flags.why: The tyre sense is mainly Southern usage, as documented in this [dialect study](https://docview.dlib.vn/tvs/2019/20190423/thuvienbrvt/tailieu_thuvienbrvt/39287_125493_1_pb_0582.pdf?rand=754329).
Hạt mưa and hạt sương are ordinary expressions used in everyday Vietnamese, so the literary tag misleadingly restricts this sense.
